An '''antiquities collector''' of [[House Panteer]],<ref name="Mission" /> one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble houses]] of<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Panteer}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="Codex" /> discovered,<ref name="Mission" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Somebody Stole My Stuff" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> that several antiquities in his collection had been stolen and replaced with fake replicas.<ref name="Mission" /> 

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to locate the stolen antiquities. Their companion successfully tracked down all of the collector's stolen items and returned to them with an amazing reward.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The antiquities collector was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Somebody Stole My Stuff" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
